post_install: python -m pip install pytest pytest-mock pytest-xdist "pytest-asyncio<0.24" pytest-cov pytest-benchmark coverage trustme cryptography websockets wsproto h11 httptools pyyaml watchfiles httpx a2wsgi

notes: Historical pyproject pytest options include xdist -n, so pytest-xdist is required.
Plugin autoload is disabled by the pipeline, so xdist.plugin must be explicitly loaded.
Pin pytest-asyncio below 0.24 to avoid newer collection-time deprecation warnings being promoted by historical warning policy.
Full collection at recent commits imports HTTP middleware/WSGI tests, so httpx and a2wsgi are required.
The test suite declares anyio-marked tests, so anyio.pytest_plugin must be explicit when plugin autoload is disabled.
Benchmark tests declare benchmark markers, so pytest-benchmark and pytest_benchmark.plugin are required for full collection.
Historical warning policy promotes the pytest-benchmark xdist warning to an error, so the profile ignores PytestBenchmarkWarning during probes and oracle runs.
